methods_quotes.q: Rate ratios (RRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated with negative binomial regression models, adjusted for county-level 7-day incidence
Rate ratios with 95% CIs excluding 1.0 were considered statistically significant.
All RR estimates except for county COVID-19 incidence were adjusted for county-level 7-day case incidence per 100,000 population on December 1, 2020.
Analyses were conducted in R (version 4.0.2; The R Foundation).
